articles.title: Brazil-Russia Nuclear Dialogue Tests Washington’s Grip on Hemisphere
articles.summary: Brazil and Russia recently signed a declaration reaffirming their commitment to the peaceful use of nuclear energy, emerging from renewed bilateral talks. This agreement highlights international cooperation on critical global technologies and diplomatic efforts to ensure stability. For SSB aspirants, it underscores how nations collaborate on dual-use technologies, a key aspect of international relations and global security.

articles.title: Norway and Germany sign defence arrangement
articles.summary: Defence Ministers signed the historic "Hansa Arrangement" on February 14, 2026. This pivotal defence pact aims to significantly strengthen European security and cooperation amidst growing global challenges. The agreement underscores the increasing importance of collective defence efforts among European nations, signaling a reinforced commitment to regional stability.
